entities.name: US Military Occupation (1916–1924)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The United States occupied the Dominican Republic from 1916 to 1924, ostensibly to stabilize finances and prevent European intervention. The occupation modernized infrastructure but was deeply resented, and the US-trained Guardia Nacional produced Rafael Trujillo.
